module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 1000) that lets a flowgraph project launch others (child projects) and exchange messages with them. Received messages are queued then distributed at the start of the next update (onFlowgraphManagerPreUpdate hook) to the nodes via broadcastCall. On stop, all launched children are stopped and removed.
notes: A message with a hook field is broadcast as a call mgr:broadcastCall(message.hook, message.data); otherwise it is broadcast as 'onThreadMessageProcess'.
targetId == -1 designates the parent (parentId); a root project has parentId = -1, so sending fails (returns false).
startProjectFromFilepath prints a dump of the children list (dumpz).

init.desc: Called when the module is created: calls clear().

clear.desc: Clears the children and the messages, sets parentId = -1 back.

afterTrigger.desc: Called after the graph tick (does nothing).

sendMessage.desc: Sends a message to the target manager (or to the parent if targetId is -1). Logs the send.

targetId.desc: id of the target flowgraph manager, -1 for the parent

onFlowgraphManagerPreUpdate.desc: Hook called before the managers update: broadcasts then clears the queue of received messages.

receiveMessage.desc: Adds a message to the receive queue and logs it.

startProjectFromFilepath.desc: Loads a flowgraph project from a file (core_flowgraphManager.loadManager), starts it, registers it as a child and gives it this manager as parent.

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: immediately stops each child, removes them on the next frame, then calls clear().

executionStarted.desc: Called when the project starts (does nothing).
